name: Kiro
tagline: An agentic development environment that turns your intent into a plan, then builds, reviews and verifies the work.
about: Kiro is an AI development tool from AWS. It writes requirements and a task plan before coding, then agents carry out and check the work in the IDE, the command line or the cloud.
pros: Writes requirements and a task plan before it writes code.
Available as an IDE and a command-line tool.
cons: Credit-based; larger jobs need a paid plan.
The planning step adds overhead for small changes.
